children: Gupta brings more than 27 years of technology experience across IT strategy, digital transformation, enterprise systems and technology operations

Akasa Air has appointed Abhishek Gupta as Chief Information Officer (CIO), effective September 2026. Gupta brings more than 27 years of experience in information technology, covering IT strategy, service delivery, digital transformation, enterprise applications, infrastructure, security and technology operations.
His appointment adds an experienced technology leader to the airline as its IT function continues to support business operations and digital capabilities.
New Technology Leadership
As CIO, Gupta will oversee the airline’s technology function, with responsibilities spanning IT strategy, operations, service management, technology programmes and digital initiatives.

His experience includes managing enterprise IT operations, evaluating technology products and delivery partners, overseeing technology programmes and working with senior business stakeholders. He has also worked across banking, manufacturing, telecom and media sectors.
Gupta’s career has included roles such as CIO, Chief Digital Officer, IT head, Vice President–IT, practice leader and programme manager.
Long DishTV Tenure

Before joining Akasa Air, Gupta spent more than 11 years with DishTV. He served as Corporate Head – Information Technology from May 2019 to August 2026, after holding the position of Vice President, IT between February 2015 and May 2019.
During his tenure, his areas of experience included software as a service (SaaS), product road mapping, application management and enterprise technology.
His broader responsibilities have included IT operations, service delivery, service management, infrastructure management, IT security and programme management.
Earlier Technology Roles
Gupta previously served as Practice Lead – Mobility and Emerging Technologies at Ericsson from April 2012 to January 2015.

Before that, he spent more than five years with Orange Business Services as Head of Corporate IT – India between October 2005 and April 2011. The role covered corporate IT operations and application management.
Earlier in his career, Gupta worked with IPsoft and Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), where he began his professional journey as an IT Analyst in 1999.

His experience also includes managing technology relationships with senior executives, account management, technology consulting and global deployment of enterprise programmes across functions including human resources, finance and knowledge management.
Academic Background

Gupta completed the One Year Post-Graduate Programme in Management for Executives (PGPX) at the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad between 2011 and 2012, where he was also associated with the placement committee.
He holds a Bachelor of Engineering degree in Mechanical Engineering from Delhi College of Engineering, completed in 1999.
In his new role at Akasa Air, Gupta will bring his experience in enterprise technology, IT operations and digital programmes to the airline’s technology function.
